content.text:
Resubmitted with the intent defects repaired.

**What changed this round (operation 2 only):**
- The follow-on sentence now supplies its own antecedent: "Subject to the Change Of Control and Assignment Sections, upon receiving a bonafide third party offer to purchase all or substantially all of its assets or to merge or consolidate, the Licensee shall have the right to consummate the transaction with the third party." — so "the transaction" and "the third party" no longer refer back to the deleted grant.
- The express subordination to the retained Change Of Control (p0134) and Assignment (p0149) sections removes the contradiction created by stripping the original condition; the sentence is no longer an unconditional right to consummate a third-party transaction.
- Operation 1 is unchanged (concise negation of the first-refusal/matching mechanic), and p0141 is preserved verbatim.

Classification remains a deviation cured at the preferred level, with the single preferred element addressed by operations 1–2 and no duplicate flag under ASSIGN.
